english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for traveling or going on one’s travels.
This is the all-purpose noun for a journey, excursion, or holiday outing.
Use this when the vacation means the trip or journey itself rather than the time off.
Use this for travelling or taking a trip, rather than sightseeing as an activity.

examples.english: I enjoy travel and seeing different places.
examples.traditional: 我鍾意旅行，去唔同地方見識下。

examples.english: We're going on a trip to Japan this summer.
examples.traditional: 我哋今個暑假去日本旅行。

examples.english: Our vacation this year was a trip to Taiwan.
